ideas.why: A small adventure, a long-running wish, and room to talk.

ideas.why: One destination, real atmosphere, and a whole evening together.

ideas.title: The city, after hours
ideas.venue: Museum of the City of New York
ideas.description: Explore the galleries, compare your favorite pieces, and pause at the pop-up bar. 1220 Fifth Avenue.
ideas.why: Art plus conversation, without a formal or expensive dinner.

ideas.why: A small, focused art date with space for your own conversation.

ideas.why: Colorful art and the rituals of cooking are a lovely overlap.
ideas.availability: Gallery hours and exhibition dates listed by the gallery; no timed-ticket requirement listed.

ideas.description: Sculptural couture, intricate materials, and shapes that barely seem possible. Pick the piece you would wear in another life.
